cap.files.text: Faka ama-PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV noma amafayela ombhalo, umsizi {name} awafunde. Izithombe nezithombe-skrini ziya ezingqondweni ezikwazi ukubona.
cap.made.text: Cela idokhumenti ye-Word, ishidi lokubala noma elinye ifayela, ulilondoloze ngokuchofoza. Kopisha izimpendulo nokuhlelwa kwazo, ulande amathebula e-Excel.
cap.documents.text: Amadokhumenti agcinwe eceleni kwengxoxo: bhala / ukuze wengeze isihloko, uhlu noma ithebula, wenze amagama agqame noma abe isixhumanisi, uhambise amabhulokhi aphelele. Izinguquko zomsizi {name} zibonakala lapho zikhona, ngayinye uyigcine noma uyihlehlise.
cap.tables.text: Amaqoqo eceleni kwengxoxo, ngalinye liboniswa njengethebula noma ibhodi. Izinguquko zomsizi {name} zimakiwe, ngayinye uyamukele noma uyenqabe. Okwamanje, adinga ingqondo esefwini noma uhlelo.
cap.computer.text: Ikhompyutha encane ngaphakathi kwale thebhu, ehlukaniswe nale divayisi: iqalisa imiyalo, i-JavaScript ne-Python kumafayela efolda yakho noma ephrojekthi, futhi ifinyelela i-inthanethi kuphela lapho uvumela khona.
cap.reflexes.text: Umsizi omncane kule divayisi ({size}, kanye) ozwa lokho okudingayo: ingqondo efanele emlayezweni ngamunye, iziphakamiso, izinto ezintsha ongazizama. Akukho okuphuma kule divayisi.
cap.meaning.text: Ithola lokho okushiwo amafayela akho, ngisho nangamanye amagama noma ngolunye ulimi, ngomsizi omncane kule divayisi ({size}, kanye). Akukho okuphuma kule divayisi.
cap.meaning.hint: Buza ngamafayela akho ngamagama ahlukile kwawo.
cap.natural-voice.text: Ifunda izimpendulo ngokuzwakalayo ngezwi elingokwemvelo elenziwa kule divayisi ({size} ngolimi, kanye). Akukho okuphuma kule divayisi.
cap.backup.text: Gcina ikhophi yakho konke efayeleni elilodwa, uyibuyisele kunoma iyiphi idivayisi.
cap.share.text: Thumela umsebenzi, ikhasi, ishadi, amaslayidi noma isithombe njengesixhumanisi esingavulwa yinoma ubani osithola.
cap.sync.text: Igcina imisebenzi yakho, amafayela nenkumbulo kufana kwamanye amakhompyutha akho, ngefolda evumelaniswa yi-OneDrive, Dropbox, iCloud Drive noma Google Drive.
cap.devices.text: Umsizi {name} nasefonini yakho noma kwenye ikhompyutha, nezingqondo zakho, izilungiselelo namaphrojekthi, kuvikelwe ukuze kufundwe amadivayisi akho kuphela. Umsebenzi uhamba usuka kwenye uye kwenye uma uwuthumela.
cap.people.text: Thumela umsebenzi, noma okwenziwe umsizi {name}, kumuntu naye osebenzisa umsizi {name}, kuvikelwe ukuze kuvulwe nguye kuphela, uthole impendulo yakhe emsebenzini ofanayo.
cap.together.text: Sebenza eqoqweni nabanye abantu ngesikhathi esisodwa, ngamunye abone izinguquko zabanye njengoba zifika futhi agcine ikhophi yakhe.
cap.lock.text: Imisebenzi yakho, amafayela nokhiye kuvuleka kuphela ngokhiye wakho wokungena noma ngephasiwedi.
cap.brain-local.text: Kuyimfihlo, kumahhala futhi akudingi inthanethi: ingqondo esebenza kule khompyutha, uma inamandla anele.
cap.files.hint: Yabelana ngefayela, noma unamathisele umbhalo omude.
cap.tables.hint: Cela ukulandelela okuthile, njengezicelo zomsebenzi noma izindleko.
cap.designs.text: Izimemo, amaphosta, amapheshana nokuthunyelwe, kuhlelwe umsizi {name} ngezindlela ezintathu eceleni kwengxoxo, ukuze ukuqedele ngesandla, bese uphrinta, uthumela noma uposa. Izinguquko zomsizi {name} zibonakala kudizayini, ngayinye uyamukele noma uyenqabe.
cap.designs.hint: Cela okuthile ozokuphrinta, ukuposa noma ukuthumela, njengesimemo noma iphosta.
cap.computer.hint: Yabelana ngeshidi lokubala, noma ucele izinombolo eziqondile.
cap.memory.hint: Khuluma ngokuthile okuhlala kukhona ngawe, njengento oyithandayo.
cap.routines.hint: Cela uhlobo olufanayo lwento ngezinsuku ezintathu ezehlukene.
cap.web-search.hint: Qala imisebenzi emihlanu, bese ubuza ngento eyaziwa iwebhu kuphela, njengezindaba zanamuhla.
cap.connections.hint: Cela okuthile kunsiza oyisebenzisayo, njenge-imeyili yakho.
cap.helpers.hint: Cela umsebenzi omkhulu onezingxenye eziningana ezihlukene.
cap.double-check.hint: Thola izimpendulo ezintathu ezicaphuna imithombo yazo.
cap.since.hint: Buya ngemuva kwesikhashana, ufake insiza exhunyiwe.
cap.notifications.hint: Iya kwenye ithebhu noma i-app ngenkathi umsebenzi uqhubeka.
cap.camera.hint: Yabelana ngezithombe ezimbili ezivela efonini noma kuthebhulethi.
cap.devices.hint: Sho ukuthi ungathanda lokhu efonini yakho noma kwenye ikhompyutha, noma ukuvule lapha.
cap.people.hint: Sho ukuthi ungathanda ukuthumela okuthile kumuntu, noma ukuvule lapha.
cap.lock.hint: Xhuma insiza, noma uqale imisebenzi eyishumi.
cap.memory.text: Umsizi {name} ukhumbula izinto ezihlala zikhona ozishoyo, njengokuthanda kwakho, amaqiniso nokulungisa. Ungakubona futhi ukushintshe konke.
cap.projects.text: Noma yini oqhubeka ubuyela kuyo ithola igumbi layo: imisebenzi yayo, amafayela, amanothi nombala wayo.
cap.folders.text: Ivula umsebenzi noma iphrojekthi efolda yale khompyutha: umsizi {name} uthola, afunde futhi ashintshe amafayela ayo lapho ekhona, futhi akubonise ushintsho ngalunye kuqala.
cap.skills.text: Uma ucela uhlobo olufanayo lwento kaningi, umsizi {name} angalondoloza ukuthi yenziwa kanjani, ayenze ngendlela efanayo njalo.
cap.routines.text: Imisebenzi eyenziwa yodwa njalo ngehora, ngosuku, ngesonto noma ngenyanga, noma kanye kamuva, njengesikhumbuzi: ngenkathi le thebhu ivuliwe, noma ngokushesha uma ubuya.
projects.name: Igama
projects.keepHere: Gcina iphrojekthi “{name}” kule divayisi kuphela? Imisebenzi namafayela ayo azophuma kwamanye amadivayisi akho. Idivayisi eyishintshile ingaxhunyiwe izowabuyisa.
projects.confirmDelete: Susa iphrojekthi “{name}”, nayo yonke imisebenzi, amafayela namanothi ayo? Lokhu akunakuhlehliswa.
cap.flows.hint: Cela kabili okuthile okuthatha izinyathelo eziningana.
cap.flows.text: Izinyathelo zomsebenzi owuphindayo, zidwetshwe eceleni kwengxoxo: zibone, uzishintshe, uziqalise futhi ngesandla noma ngesikhathi esihleliwe. Noma yimuphi umsebenzi ungabonwa njengomzila.
cap.starters.hint: Cela uhlobo olufanayo lwento kathathu, uma Amakhono esetholakele noma enqatshiwe.
cap.starters.text: Izicelo ozenza kaningi, ngaphansi kwebhokisi emsebenzini omusha, ziseduze: ezakho, zezindawo zonke noma zephrojekthi eyodwa, nalokho ovame ukukucela. Uzishintsha kuzilungiselelo.
cap.web-search.text: Umsizi {name} ubheka izinto kuwebhu uma umbuzo udinga amaqiniso angenawo, futhi abonise ukuthi impendulo ngayinye ivelaphi.
cap.browser.text: Ibonisa amakhasi ewebhu eceleni kwengxoxo, nokubuyela emuva, phambili nokulayisha kabusha. Umsizi {name} angavula amakhasi lapho, futhi uyazi ukuthi yiliphi elivuliwe.
cap.connections.text: Xhuma izinsiza ozisebenzisayo, njenge-imeyili yakho noma amadokhumenti. Umsizi {name} ufunda futhi enze lapho kuphela ngemvume yakho.
cap.live.text: Khuluma nomsizi {name} ngaphandle kwezandla: uyalalela, aphendule ngokuzwakalayo, futhi ame uma ukhuluma. Cishe {size}, kanye.
cap.camera.text: Khuluma ngaphandle kwezandla ngalokho okuphambi kwakho: konke okushoyo kuhamba nalokho okuboniswa yikhamera, futhi ingaqhubeka ibuka bese ikhuluma uma kukhona okubalulekile. Kugcinwa kuphela izithombe ezibukiwe, emsebenzini.
cap.screen.text: Bonisa iwindi, ithebhu noma isikrini sakho sonke ngenkathi usebenza kwenye i-app: konke okushoyo kuhamba nalokho okubonisiwe, futhi ukubuka kungaqhubeka, ngegama uma isinyathelo siqediwe noma kukhona okungahambanga kahle. Akukho okuchofozwayo noma okubhalwayo lapho. Kugcinwa kuphela izithombe ezibukiwe, emsebenzini.
cap.helpers.text: Emsebenzini omkhulu, umsizi {name} uhlukanisa umsebenzi ube izingxenye, ngayinye yenziwe umlekeleli, zonke ngesikhathi esisodwa. Uvuma lokho abakwenzayo, ikhadi ngalinye.
cap.extensions.text: Engeza izengezo ukuze wenze okwengeziwe, njengokuhlola okuthunyelwayo. Ngasinye sigcinwa kude namafayela akho nokhiye, futhi senza kuphela lokho okuvumelile.
cap.double-check.text: Umsizi {name} uhlola isimangalo ngasinye sempendulo nomthombo esiwucaphunayo, futhi akubonise okungasekelwa yimithombo.
cap.since.text: Uma ubuya, isifinyezo esifushane salokho okusha ezinsizeni zakho ezixhunyiwe. Kuyafunda kuphela, futhi akukho okufundwayo ngenkathi le thebhu ivaliwe.
cap.notifications.text: Isaziso uma umsebenzi uqediwe noma ukulindile ngenkathi ungekho. Kuboniswa isihloko sawo kuphela, hhayi impendulo.
cap.names.text: Nika umsizi wephrojekthi igama lakhe, namagama ambalwa ngokuthi kufanele abe njani.
projects.personaHint: Isibonelo: onomusa futhi omfushane, njengompheki wamakhekhe
keyboard.leave: Ukuze uphume ethebuleni noma ohlwini, cindezela u-Esc, bese u-Tab.
keyboard.recall: Izicelo zangaphambili, uma umlayezo wakho ungenalutho
settings.voiceText: Impendulo ngolunye ulimi ifundwa ngezwi lalolo limi.
guards.if: Kuphela uma impendulo ithi yebo ku… (akuphoqelekile)
settings.sample: Sawubona! Yile ndlela izimpendulo zakho ezizozwakala ngayo uma zifundwa ngokuzwakalayo.

pages.title: Amakhasi ewebhu nama-app
pages.text: Lokho ikhasi lewebhu noma i-app engakwenza uma ivuleka eceleni kwengxoxo.
pages.downloadsText: Izinkinobho zalo zingalondoloza ithebula noma isithombe elikwenzile.
pages.webText: Izithombe, amafonti nekhodi exhunyaniswe nalo. Lawo masayithi angazi ukuthi ikhasi livuliwe.
pages.networkText: Ikhodi yalo ingafinyelela amasayithi owavumelayo. Kuphela kumakhasi owathembayo.
pages.mapsText: Kusuka kunsiza yamamephu ku-inthanethi, ebona izindawo ezibonisiwe.
pages.sitesText: Bhala isayithi, bese ucindezela u-Enter. * yinoma iyiphi isayithi; *.example.com yikho konke amakheli e-example.com.
knows.title: Lokho umsizi {name} akwaziyo ngawe
you.name: Igama lakho
cap.find.text: Ithola noma yimuphi umsebenzi, ifayela noma isilungiselelo njengoba ubhala: ingxenye yegama yanele.
brain.key.label: Ukhiye
brain.device.title: Kule divayisi
cap.machine.hint: Cela ukuqalisa iseva yokuthuthukisa yesayithi, njenge-npm run dev.
cap.machine.text: Iqalisa imiyalo kule khompyutha uqobo, efolda yakho, nezinhlelo namaseva ayo: iseva yokuthuthukisa yesayithi ibonakala esipheqululini. Umyalo ngamunye ubuzwa kuqala, futhi u-Ctrl+C kutheminali yakho ukumisa konke.
cap.pictures.text: Izithombe namafilimu amafushane ngencazelo, noma isithombe sakho esishintshiwe: ngezingqondo ozixhumayo, noma ngasese kule divayisi. Ifilimu ibuzwa kuqala, ngoba ibiza kakhulu.
cap.feedback.text: Ngaphansi kwempendulo yokugcina, yimake njengenhle noma engalungile. Okuthi Akulungile kubuza ukuthi yini engekho, kuphendule futhi ngengqondo enamandla, futhi kungakukhumbula ngokuzayo, kule divayisi.
